name: Trazodone
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Modest 2.5 uM sALS iPSC-MN survival gain in Bye 2025 (+1.846d, 13/15 lines, paired p=0.00150, q=0.0161).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Peer-reviewed MND-SMART Phase 3 RCT (NCT04302870, PMID:39307154, N=371 arm comparison) stopped for futility at 200 mg/d (ALSFRS-R -0.625 vs -0.655 pts/mo, p=0.24; deaths 52 vs 48; AEs 90% vs 77%); Cu,brain (~280 nM) is 8.94x below 2.5 uM screen and 53.6x below 15 uM ISR assay while 16.5x above 5-HT2A IC50 (17 nM); direct eIF2B activators ABBV-CLS-7262 (DRR=1.06 [0.850, 1.324], Serum NfL ratio 1.092, p=0.0253, n=281) & DNL343 (DRR=1.06 [0.840, 1.351], Plasma NfL +0.080 ng/L, p=0.0304, N=249) failed Phase 2/3.
factual_justification: Falsified directly in human ALS Phase 3 RCT (MND-SMART NCT04302870, p=0.24 futility), compounded by an 8.9-54x human unbound brain PK deficit vs in vitro rescue/ISR concentrations and class-wide human NfL elevation with selective eIF2B activators.

name: Riluzole
evidence_proves_hypothesis: FDA-approved ALS survival standard of care (+2-3 mo) and #1 hit across all 107 drugs in Bye 2025 (+3.959d, 16/16 [100%] sALS lines > DMSO, p=1.24e-12, q=1.32e-10), reversing 10/10 SALS DEGs (r=-0.952, p=2.28e-5; KCNN1 +1.32 log2FC) and 45/45 GO sets when assayed in mature BrainPhys Stage 4 media (SCN8A TDP-43 |dPSI|=0.2019, FDR=1.95e-6).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Not a novel white-space discovery asset; human ALS CSF (~115 nM at 50 mg BID) achieves only ~0.23x NaV1.6 persistent Na+ IC50 (~500 nM), capping clinical survival benefit.
factual_justification: Reclassified as Track A positive clinical and iPSC-MN phenotypic/transcriptomic calibration benchmark (Rank #1/107 in Bye 2025; approved background standard of care).

name: Baricitinib
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rank #2/107 in Bye 2025 pure sALS iPSC-MNs (+3.774d, 14/16 lines, p=2.56e-7, q=6.85e-6); TDP-43 KD induces neuronal JAK2 3'UTR shortening (dPAS=-0.4391, padj=2.96e-61) & AAK1 lengthening (dPAS=+0.1673, padj=6.32e-16); NYGC ALS-Glia (n=38 vs 46 Ctrl, p=0.00517; cord JAK1/2 p<2e-7) enriches JAK-STAT; NADALS (NCT05189106, n=8-9 ALS) proves 3.80 nM CSF entry at 4 mg/d with -38.1% CSF CXCL10 reduction and stable CSF NfL (5523->5796->5504 pg/mL).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: P-gp/BCRP efflux limits Kp,uu,CSF to ~0.05-0.11 (3.80 nM CSF = 0.095x whole-cell pSTAT IC50 ~40 nM; 657x below 2.5 uM screen); ALS-TE cortex JAK-STAT is not detected (p=0.257); gnomAD v4 oeUpper JAK1=0.178, JAK2=0.739 + FDA Boxed Warnings (PE=166/DVT=116 in FAERS) bar unstratified chronic dosing.
factual_justification: Human ALS CSF CXCL10 target engagement (-38.1% at 4 mg/d) and neuronal TDP-43 JAK2 3'UTR APA + pure-MN survival rescue are compelling, but no randomized ALS trial exists and 3.8 nM CSF is 657x below the 2.5 uM iPSC screen concentration.
discriminating_next_test: Test clinically relevant unbound CSF concentrations (3.8 nM, 20 nM, 50 nM vs 2,500 nM) in Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MN +/- IFN-gamma/microglia co-cultures with CRISPR JAK1/JAK2 vs AAK1 epistasis before any CSF CXCL10 + CHIT1-enriched Phase 2 RCT.

name: Apilimod
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rescues mean Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MN survival at 2.5 uM (+1.837d, 12/16 lines, p=0.00210, q=0.0173); AIT-101 125 mg BID in C9orf72-ALS (NCT05163886, N=15) reached 3.89 nM CSF (Kp,uu~0.72), cutting 12-wk randomized CSF poly(GP) by 74.4% with CSF NfL -5.0% (6,706.8->6,372.7 pg/mL vs +9.1% pbo) and 0 drug-related SAEs.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: D045 CSF GDI2 is null in sALS vs Ctrl (TMT diff_log2=+0.0245, p=0.208; DIA +0.0200, p=0.504; C9 only p=0.00598/0.0268); 4/16 (25%, 0 ties) sALS lines worsened; NCT05163886 CSF sGPNMB was unchanged (p=0.352) while Wk12 Plasma NfL rose +39.2% & Wk24 OLE CSF NfL rose +49.7% (n=4/10), and VRG50635 caused 2/6 (33%) encephalopathy/renal SAEs in Ph1 (NCT06286475, PMC12916242) plus astrocytic GFAP+NfL co-elevation & 8/54 (14.8%) drug SAEs in ALS (NCT06215755; PIKFYVE oeUpper=0.550, MGI brain vacuoles), refuting naive benign NfL exosome-flushing for continuous dosing.
factual_justification: 12-wk randomized C9orf72-ALS target engagement (-74.4% CSF poly(GP), -5.0% CSF NfL, N=15 unpowered) and untested sALS status forbid DROP, but continuous PIKfyve blockade hits a human vacuolation/encephalopathy/NfL+GFAP toxicity wall.
discriminating_next_test: Strict pulsed nanomolar kill gate (2-15 nM, e.g., 48h on / 120h off vs continuous) in C9orf72 and sALS iPSC-MNs: advance ONLY if pulsed dosing preserves poly(GP)/TDP-43 clearance with zero cytoplasmic vacuolation and zero supernatant NfL or cleaved caspase-3 elevation.

name: Icerguastat (IFB-088 / Sephin1)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Modest survival gain at 2.5 uM in Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MNs (+1.618d, 13/16 lines, p=0.00202, q=0.0173); Zeng 2025 PPP1R15A dPAS=+0.0558 (padj=6.42e-8).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: ExploreALS cited corrupt IDs (CHEMBL3545058=Dextrothyroxine, CID:5702546=Resiniferatoxin; true Sephin1=CHEMBL2365743/CID:9561611, MW 196.64); direct PPP1R15A inhibition refuted (PMID:28447936; acts via 1-5 uM GluN2B/PHB2); in Phase 2 NCT05508074 (N=51), extreme first-pass clearance (CL/F=580 L/h in ALS; 736-1,388 L/h in Ph1 = 6.4-15.4x hepatic blood flow) capped GeoMean plasma Cmax at 12 ng/mL (GeoCV 66.4%, 61.0 nM, Cu,brain~13.0 nM = 193x below 2.5 uM) with flat ISR biomarker GDF15 (704.3->711.3->704.9 ng/mL), null ITT ALSFRS-R (-0.33, p=0.923), AND 2/34 (5.9% vs 0% pbo) drug-related fatal TEAEs, 3/34 (8.8%) Grade>=3 drug TEAEs/discontinuations, cardiac/cardiorespiratory arrest, and 8/34 (23.5% vs 0%) falls.
factual_justification: Falsified by a non-closable human PK/safety wall: extreme first-pass clearance (6.4-15.4x hepatic blood flow) caps Cu,brain at ~13.0 nM (193x below 2.5 uM active concentration, with flat human ISR GDF15 and null ITT ALSFRS-R p=0.923), while 25 mg BID already produced 2/34 (5.9% vs 0%) investigator-attributed drug-related fatal TEAEs and 23.5% falls, making 80-200x dose escalation toxicologically impossible.
